verses.t: “For insight into hate … delusion … anger … acrimony … disdain … contempt … jealousy … stinginess … deceitfulness … deviousness … obstinacy … aggression … conceit … arrogance … vanity … For insight into negligence … complete understanding … complete ending … giving up … ending … vanishing … fading away … cessation … giving away … For the letting go of negligence these seven things should be developed.”
That is what the Buddha said. Satisfied, the mendicants approved what the Buddha said. The Book of the Sevens is finished.
